description: Assess channel slices only after acquisition cost, downstream value and attribution windows share compatible units and scope.

guide.applicability: Use when a project has reviewed channel identity, cost and downstream-value semantics for the same cohort window.
guide.context_boundary: Channel labels and attribution windows cannot be inferred from result fields, and descriptive differences do not establish channel causality.
steps: Resolve channel identity, acquisition-cost and downstream-value definitions for one cohort scope.
Compare matched returned channel rows while preserving missing, partial and unknown completeness states.
Report observable quality signals, excluded channels and the evidence still required for an allocation decision.
guide.title: Channel evidence quality review

summary: Compare returned channel observations under one explicit value and cost contract.
